problem_statement: This is the DIVA jewellery storefront: a static multi-page shop with a shared top nav (Home, Campaign, Products, Contact, About), a home page of collection tiles, and a Products page (products.html) that lays out sixteen jewellery pieces grouped under Gold and Diamond headings, each a card linking to its category page. The store team wants to make the Products page actually shoppable and to surface a shopping-bag badge across the store. Ship: (1) a product-grid filter above the grid on the Products page with tabs (All, Gold, Diamond, Earrings, Necklaces) and a live result readout that reads 'Showing N of 16 · Label', so clicking Gold filters the grid to the nine gold pieces and the readout updates to 'Showing 9 of 16 · Gold'; (2) a shopping-bag badge (a 'Bag' label with a numeric cart-count pill) in the always-present nav on the Home, Campaign AND About pages; (3) the filter row must lay out responsively so the Products page never overflows horizontally on a 390px phone; and (4) the grid, filter panel and cards must stay on the store's dark-and-gold brand and remain a tidy, legible grid — not a pale off-brand slab and not a broken pile of overlapping, clipped cards. Keep the existing pages, product images, nav and footer intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a product-grid filter above the grid on the Products page with tabs All, Gold, Diamond, Earrings and Necklaces, and a result readout that reads 'Showing N of 16 · Label'.

Wire the filter so clicking the Gold tab shows only the nine gold pieces and the readout updates from 'Showing 16 of 16 · All' to 'Showing 9 of 16 · Gold' — it must recompute the live count, not show a stale captured value.

Add a shopping-bag badge (a 'Bag' label plus a numeric cart-count pill) into the always-present store nav so it renders on the Home, Campaign AND About pages — a shared component, not a single-page copy.
The filter tab row must wrap responsively so the Products page never overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).
Keep the shop panel, filter and product cards on the dark-and-gold brand and laid out as a tidy grid — not a pale off-brand slab and not overlapping, clipped cards.
Preserve the existing pages, product images, top nav and footer with no console or network errors.
design_constraints: Implement the shopping-bag badge as a shared nav component so a single source of truth reaches Home, Campaign and About; do not paste divergent copies or ship it on one page only.
The filter tab row must use a fluid, wrapping layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The shop panel, filter and product grid must adopt the store's dark ground with gold accents and remain a legible, non-overlapping grid — not a light-cream slab and not cards shingled by negative margins or clipped to slivers.
The result readout must recompute the shown count and category label after every tab click by reading the live filter state, so it can never go stale relative to the highlighted tab.
Do not remove or regress the existing pages, the product imagery, the top nav or the footer.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the Home storefront across viewports.
desktop_products and mobile_products protect the Products page and its product grid.
desktop_shop_grid scrolls the shop filter panel and product grid into view and must show the dark-and-gold panel with a tidy grid.
mobile_shop_grid scrolls the filter row into view on a 390px phone and must not overflow horizontally.
desktop_campaign and desktop_about must carry the shared shopping-bag badge in the nav.
desktop_shop_gold clicks the Gold filter tab; the readout must then read 'Showing 9 of 16 · Gold'.

change_completion: The shopping-bag badge is present in the nav on the Home, Campaign AND About pages (the shared component reaches all three).
After clicking the Gold tab on the Products page, the readout updates to 'Showing 9 of 16 · Gold' — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing 16 of 16 · All'.
design_consistency: The shop panel and product grid on the shop states match the reference's dark-and-gold styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not a pale slab or a collapsed overlapping grid.
The filter panel and cards adopt the store's dark ground and gold accents so they read as part of the storefront.
responsive: No captured surface overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the filter tab row wraps.
desktop_shop_grid and mobile_shop_grid keep the filter panel and product grid readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The existing pages, the top nav and the footer remain present.
The product imagery and the static build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

author_notes: slot_226 DEDUP + L4 hardening onto the argha-paul-2002 Diva jewellery storefront (reassigned off the shared Creative-Md-Arif Ecommerce-website repo to remove a duplicate with slot_147). The Diva storefront is a self-contained static multi-page shop (index/products/campaign/about plus category pages) with local product photography and a dark-and-gold jewellery brand; the pages, product imagery, nav and footer are byte-identical across legs. The L4 levers ride on a native product-grid filter added above the existing Products grid plus a shopping-bag badge injected into the shared nav. reference = filter with a fluid wrapping tab row, a tidy dark-and-gold product grid, a live 'Showing N of 16' readout, and the bag badge on Home/Campaign/About (passes D2/D3/D4/D6). baseline = the original half-finished pass: the bag badge is on Home only (fails D2 cross-page on Campaign/About), the filter tab row is a fixed 760px nowrap strip (fails D6 mobile overflow ~756px), and the shop panel is repainted a pale off-brand cream slab (fails D3 visual), but its filter wiring is correct so the readout updates on click (passes D4). bad = a 'smart wrong' shop: the bag badge is Home only (fails D2), the tab row is a 600px nowrap strip with only a decorative inner overflow-x:hidden non-fix (fails D6 mobile ~666px), the product cards are shingled by negative margins and clipped to 96px slivers so the grid is a broken illegible pile (fails D3 pixel/ssim/block_fidelity), and the readout is rewritten to a value snapshotted once at init so it stays 'Showing 16 of 16 · All' after Gold is clicked (fails D4) — bad fails 4 orthogonal gates. Every leg is served static and is offline-clean with no console or network errors.
